footnote_text: This security represents restricted stock units ("RSUs"). Each RSU represents a contingent right to receive one share of Common Stock of the Issuer. The vesting schedule of the RSUs shall be: forty percent (40%) on July 1, 2027, forty percent (40%) in four equal quarterly installments beginning on October 1, 2027, and twenty percent (20%) in four equal quarterly installments beginning on October 1, 2028, subject to the Reporting Person's continued service with the Issuer through each applicable vesting date.
